title: GVK One

{{Use Indian English|date=March 2015}} {{Use dmy dates|date=February 2025}} {{Infobox shopping mall | name = GVK One | image = GVK Mall Hyderabad.jpg | image_width = | caption = | location = [[Banjara Hills]], Hyderabad, India | coordinates = {{coord|17.419217|78.448386|display=inline,title}} | address = | opening_date = 1 May 2009 | closing_date = | developer = [[GVK Group]] | manager = | owner = | architect = DP Architects Pvt Ltd
M/s Shapoorji Pallonji (main contractor) | number_of_stores = 70 | number_of_anchors = 1 | floor_area = {{convert|350000|sqft|abbr=on}} | parking = 700 | floors = 7 | website = {{URL|gvkone.com}} | footnotes = }} '''GVK One''' is a shopping mall located in [[Banjara Hills]], Hyderabad, India.{{cite web|title=About GVK one|url=https://www.gvkone.com/|work=gvkone.com|access-date=16 March 2012}} The {{convert|350000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}} mall was opened to public on 1 May 2009.{{cite web|title=GVK One launched in Hyderabad on 1st May|url=https://www.idlebrain.com/community/etc/launch-gvkone.html|work=idlebrain.com|access-date=16 March 2012}} == Design == GVK One was designed by [[DP Architects]] of [[Singapore]] and built by [[Shapoorji Pallonji Group|Shapoorji Pallonji & Company]] between 2004 and 2005 under a ₹30 crore civil contract.{{cite news |title=GVK One mega mall in the making |work=Business Standard |date=3 January 2004 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/management/gvk-one-mega-mall-in-the-making-104010301067_1.html |access-date=2025-07-04}} The 11‑storey reinforced concrete structure features a [[Curtain wall (architecture)|curtain wall]] facade combining large glass panels. A central skylit atrium spans the seven public levels, with eight escalators and ten elevators arranged around two elevator cores to facilitate circulation. Five basement floors provide over 300,000 sft of parking for more than 1,000 vehicles, managed by an automated system that guides drivers to available bays.{{Cite news |last=Rajanala |first=Sunil |date=2004-02-24 |title=GVK One Mall to open for public by July 2005 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/gvk-one-mall-to-open-for-public-by-july-2005/articleshow/515649.cms |access-date=2025-07-04 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} == Facilities == GVK One encompasses approximately 650,000 sq ft of retail and leisure space. The mall has 70 branded stores and its anchor store [[Shoppers Stop]] spans {{convert|60000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}} in three levels.{{cite news|title=GVK One thrown open to public |url=http://www.hindu.com/2009/05/02/stories/2009050260190500.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090504093624/http://www.hindu.com/2009/05/02/stories/2009050260190500.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=4 May 2009|access-date=16 March 2012|newspaper=The Hindu|date=2 May 2009}} The mall has a six-screen [[INOX Leisure Limited|INOX]] multiplex COVERING OVER 40,000 sft housed in it. The mall is established and promoted by GVK Power and Infrastructure limited.{{cite news|title=GVK One looking to open more malls |url=http://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Hyderabad/article2712583.ece |access-date=16 March 2012|newspaper=The Hindu|date=14 December 2011}} In September 2023, the [[Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation]] (GHMC) approved the construction of a modern foot overbridge adjacent to GVK One mall on Road No. 1, [[Banjara Hills]]. The 55m wide structure was fabricated from mild steel.{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=T. N. M. |date=2022-09-26 |title=GHMC to build swanky foot overbridge in Hyderabad’s Banjara Hills |url=https://www.thenewsminute.com/telangana/ghmc-build-swanky-foot-over-bridge-hyderabad-s-banjara-hill-168302 |access-date=2025-07-04 |website=The News Minute |language=en}} The bridge will also be equipped with cladding and [[Closed-circuit television camera|CCTV cameras]] to enhance security. Designed to alleviate accidents on one of the city’s busiest roads and to serve the substantial daily footfall generated by the adjacent commercial mall, the overbridge prioritizes both accessibility and safety.{{Cite web |date=2022-09-26 |title=Foot over Bridge near GVK Mall in Hyderabad to be the swankiest one |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/hyderabad/2022/Sep/26/foot-over-bridge-near-gvk-mall-in-hyderabad-to-be-the-swankiest-one-2501932.html |access-date=2025-07-04 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{commons category}} {{Shopping malls in India}} [[Category:Shopping malls in Hyderabad, India]] [[Category:Shopping malls established in 2009]] [[Category:2009 establishments in Andhra Pradesh]]
extract: GVK One is a shopping mall located in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, India. The 350,000 sq ft (33,000 m2) mall was opened to public on 1 May 2009.
